overview.body:
Reagan Crossing Phase II is a mixed-use office, retail and drive-thru development on Ronald Reagan Blvd at Journey Parkway in Leander, TX, developed by The Prime Developer. It is the second phase of Reagan Crossing, next to [Reagan Crossing Phase I](/properties/reagan-crossing-phase-1).

The buildings stack 21,000 SF of ground-floor retail under 21,000 SF of medical and professional offices, with 12,000 SF of drive-thru space and more than 269 parking spaces. Offices are available to buy, a rare chance to own office space in [Leander](/leander) instead of renting.

Four Phase II units are already leased on 10-year NNN leases at a fixed cap rate. They are [cap rate properties](/investors) for buyers who want an NNN investment property in the Austin area with a tenant in place.
